scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
